sourceNote: フュージョンアーツ: Sword & Shield era Japanese set, 30 packs x 5 cards. ANCHORED to the same site's measured tally of パラダイムトリガー (500 boxes): SR band (SR + special-art SR) ~75%/box, HR+UR ~30%/box, one SR-or-better per box, RR/RRR (V and VMAX/VSTAR) ~4.5/box from the box breakdowns. Confidence LOW: sibling-era measurement, not this set's own. Character Rares (CHR/CSR), where this set has them, are catalogued but NOT given a pull slot — no tallied rate exists, so they contribute zero EV rather than a guessed amount (conservative). Guarantees are folded into the rates, not modelled as floors.
